title: Can your brain grow new neurons? How researchers are solving a century-old puzzle
title_zh: 你的大脑能否再生新神经元？研究者如何破解百年难题
abstract: Scientists have debated for decades whether the human brain sprouts new neurons throughout life. What would it mean if it could — and how much evidence is enough?
abstract_zh: 科学家们已争论数十年，人类大脑是否能在一生中不断产生新神经元。若能实现，这将意味着什么？以及需要多少证据才能确凿？
snippet: Scientists have debated for decades whether the human brain sprouts new neurons throughout life. What would it mean if it could — and how much evidence is enough?
